# OEO Energy Solutions

> > OEO Energy Solutions provides commercial and industrial LED lighting products including high bay fixtures, wall packs, tubes, and retrofit solutions with selectable features for energy efficiency.

Based in Lake Zurich, IL, OEO Energy Solutions specializes in advanced LED lighting systems featuring plug-and-play retrofit technology, ballast-bypass solutions, and innovative selectable options for wattage, color temperature, and beam angles. The company partners with brands like LedVance and Sylvania to deliver energy-efficient lighting for warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and commercial properties.

## Key Topics

- LED high bay lighting
- Commercial and industrial lighting
- LedVance products
- Sylvania LED wall packs and area lights
- Plug-and-play retrofit solutions
- Ballast-bypass LED tubes
- Selectable wattage and color temperature
- Energy efficiency and utility rebates
- T8 LED tube replacements
- OEO EZ LED HB Classic Series
- All-In-One High Bay (A1HB)
- No-rewiring installations
- CCT selectable fixtures
